title: Wither Skulled
description: Ever wanted a more balanced way to craft wither skeleton skulls? Now you can!
body:
Some people prefer their wither skeleton skulls basically handed to them on a silver platter or crafted with easily accessible materials. What if you went with the later and wanted to be able to craft them but wanted to actually have to work a bit and explore to be able to do so?

**Are you someone who just finds those echo shards sitting in your chests to be useless since you already have a recovery compass?**

_Well with this Mod/Datapack, that's no longer the case! This datapack offers (what I personally believe) is a much more balanced approach to crafting wither skeleton skulls and also to make use of two items that don't really have uses!_

Using a single echo shard and a skull surrounded with some soul sand/soil. You now can craft a single skull! Encouraging you to break all those skulls around ancient cities and to horde those echo shards! **Not too easily craftable and doesn't simply hand them to you on a silver platter with almost always dropping skulls from wither skeletons!**
